column3: (Vulnerable JS Library: a known-vulnerable script served by the site, such as Swagger UI's)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set: Caddy sets it on every response)
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set: only Swagger UI, left out of the policy on purpose, ADR 0015)
(Timestamp Disclosure: numbers inside Swagger UI's bundled scripts, not timestamps)
(Authentication Request Identified: informational, the sign-in form)
(Session Management Response Identified: informational, the session cookie)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: the site needs no cross-origin isolation)
